decision: Resolve window placement in the reducer, from a placement request on window.open, instead of in the consumer from a state snapshot
why: openNewNote awaits a database write before opening, so every note in one burst placed against the same stale canvas
evidence: Live app: four seeded notes all at rect 210.588,400
result: Polkadot deletes its own getPlacedRect; staleness is now structurally unreachable

decision: Let the vacancy search grow outward past bounds instead of returning an occupied rect
why: With the library rail open the content region was 512x388, which fits exactly one 360x240 note, so the candidate grid had one cell
evidence: Live app: notes still landed on each other after the reducer fix
result: Four notes open at 423,995 / 731 / 467 / 203 with no overlap

decision: Reveal a window the canvas placed, replacing the detail-level navigation heuristic
why: A placed window can land off screen, which is the cost of preferring free space; the already-open branch already revealed
evidence: Vacancy search can now return a rect outside the viewport
result: Opening a note always shows the note, by either branch
